_CORRECTION: placement_census_by_model IS VARIANT-COLLAPSED. It credits every record to variant 0's model, so 'o0c_fence 579' is really o0c_fence 450 + o0c_fence4 129, 'o0c_shfence 632' is o0c_shfence 318 + o0c_dgfance 314, 'o0c_gun01 720' is o0c_gun01 651 + o0c_gun02 69 and 'o0c_needle 382' is o0c_needle 304 + o0c_poisonm 78. The per-variant split is in data/object_placement_per_room.json, generated by tools/objplace.py.

unresolved_factory_index IS STAGE-REGISTRY-ONLY. Seven of its twelve indices -- 4, 7, 8, 24, 26, 35, 44 -- are declared by the object/special/special_<tag>_prm.rel family, which is also in factory_tables above under the 13 'special_special_*' keys. Only 1, 6, 9, 27, 29 and 42 have no row anywhere; all six read variant 0xFF.
It also predates the nof+16 NOF0 correction (bc66060), so its counts are four records short -- o0c_trebox is 3119, not 3115.
Neither block has a generator in this repo, so they are left as published rather than hand-edited; read data/object_placement_per_room.json for the corrected numbers.

AND THE REMAINING SIX ARE NOT UNRESOLVED EITHER -- they are a different KIND of entry. 1, 6, 9, 27, 29 and 42 read variant 0xFF because none of them takes its subtype from the record: each reads its own PARAMETER BLOCK, so a (factory index, variant) row has nothing to say about them and this table was never going to name them. They are the player entry point (0x0401), the town-service counter (0x0806), the Mayor's Office (0x0C09), an authored trigger volume (0x281B), a field scene-effect volume (0x241D) and an ambient sound emitter (0x042A). They are EMITTED, with their decoded parameters, in the `volumes` list of data/object_placement_per_room.json; see its `volumes_rule`. So the name `unresolved_factory_index` is wrong on both halves of this table's twelve entries -- seven were resolved in the special tier, and the other five plus index 9 are mechanisms.
